assignments.node_id: וכל אחד ואחד מישראל נעשה בחינת לב למקום
assignments.reason: This node describes each Israelite becoming a bechina of lev (heart) for the place where a heart is needed. Its essential nature is Israel-as-heart — the very identity that defines Package 1. The node is the culmination of the heart metaphor: Israel IS the heart of the world, and here each individual Israelite becomes that heart in their appointed place.

This node describes the heart returning to burn for God. Its essential nature is the burning/yearning of the heart — the defining function of the lev in this Torah. The heart's purpose is to burn for Hashem, and this node names exactly that state. It belongs in Package 1 because burning-for-God is what the heart (Israel) does when functioning properly.

assignments.node_id: וחוזרין ונתחברין חלקי האש שבכל אחד ואחד מישראל, ונתקשרין ישראל ביחד
assignments.reason: This node describes the fire-parts of each Israelite reconnecting and Israel uniting together. Its essential nature is the reconstitution of Israel's collective heart-fire — the parts of the fire (חלקי האש) that had been separated by עפרוריות reuniting so that Israel becomes one heart again. This is the restoration of the heart's integrity, squarely within the domain of Package 1 (Israel and the Heart).

assignments.node_id: מנהיגי הדור לנפח העפרוריות מן הלב, דהינו מכל אחד מישראל
assignments.reason: This node describes the leaders of the generation blowing (נפח) the dust away from the heart. Its essential nature is the leaders' act of blowing — the defining function of the רוח (wind/spirit) that characterizes Package 2. The leaders ARE the wind, and blowing away dust is the primary expression of their wind-nature. Though the node mentions the heart and the dust, the subject and actor is the leaders exercising their ruach, which places its essential identity in Package 2.
